decision.reason: The cited note [ev-4ca241aa627b] only says `filterStateObjectsToLog` should use `upstream_peer` instead of `wasm.upstream_peer`. The telemetry section explains why: peer metadata now lives in `filter_state.upstream_peer` rather than `filter_state["wasm.upstream_peer"]` [ev-7e3267b542c5]. Neither text says where `filterStateObjectsToLog` is set: Istio may generate it internally, or users may write it themselves. Nor do they say what went wrong before the fix (for example, missing upstream peer data in access logs) or whether operators must change anything. Without the linked PR or the access-log configuration docs, the change type, which environments are exposed and what happens if nothing is done cannot be written down.
